verse.verse_1: The Hour is drawing near, and the moon is split (in two).
verse.verse_2: Yet if they see a sign (the unbelievers) turn their backs and say: 'This is but a continuation of sorcery'
verse.verse_3: They have belied, and follow their own fancies. But, every issue will be settled!
verse.verse_4: Tidings containing a deterrent have come to them
verse.verse_5: which are full of wisdom; but the warnings do not help.
verse.verse_6: Therefore, turn away from them. On the Day when the Caller summons them to a terrible thing,
verse.verse_7: their eyes will be humbled as they come out from their graves as if they were scattered locusts,
verse.verse_8: running (with their necks extended) to the Caller. The unbelievers will say: 'This is indeed a harsh Day'
verse.verse_9: (Long) before them the nation of Noah belied. They belied Our worshiper saying: 'Mad' and he was reprimanded.
verse.verse_10: Then he supplicated to his Lord, (saying): 'I am overcome, help me'
verse.verse_11: We opened the Gates of Heaven with torrential water
verse.verse_12: and caused the earth to gush with springs, so that the waters met for a predestined matter.
verse.verse_13: We carried him in a well built, watertight vessel made from planks (of wood)
verse.verse_14: that ran on under Our Eyes, a recompense for him because he had been disbelieved.
verse.verse_15: We have left it as a sign. Is there any that will remember?
verse.verse_16: How then were My punishment and My warnings!
verse.verse_17: We have made the Koran easy to remember, is there any that will remember!
verse.verse_18: Aad too belied. How then were My punishment and My warnings!
verse.verse_19: And We sent against them a howling wind in a Day of continuous of ill fortune
verse.verse_20: and snatched people up as though they were stumps of uprooted palmtrees.
verse.verse_21: How then were My punishment and My warnings!
verse.verse_22: We have made the Koran easy to remember, is there any that will remember?
verse.verse_24: They said: 'Are we to follow a mortal who is one of us? Then indeed, we would surely be in error and insane.
verse.verse_25: Out of all of us has the Reminder been given to him alone? Rather, he is indeed an arrogant liar'
verse.verse_26: (To him We said): 'Tomorrow they shall know who is the arrogant liar.
verse.verse_27: We are sending to them as a trial, a shecamel, so watch them and have patience.
verse.verse_28: Tell them that the water is to be divided between them, a drink each for them in turn'
verse.verse_29: But they called their companion who took hold of her and hamstrung her.
verse.verse_30: How then were My punishment and My warnings!
verse.verse_31: Then We sent against them one Shout and they became like the trampled twigs of the (sheep) penbuilder.
verse.verse_32: We have made the Koran an easy Remembrance, is there any that will remember!
verse.verse_33: The nation of Lot belied Our warnings.
verse.verse_34: We let loose on all of them a squall of claystones, except for the house of Lot whom We saved at dawn
verse.verse_35: through Our Mercy. So it is that We recompense the thankful.
verse.verse_36: He had warned them of Our assault but they disputed the warnings.
verse.verse_37: They even solicited of him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes: 'Now, taste My punishment and My warnings'
verse.verse_38: And at daybreak a determined punishment came upon them.
verse.verse_39: 'Now, taste My punishment and My warnings'
verse.verse_40: We have made the Koran an easy Remembrance, is there any that will remember!
verse.verse_41: The warnings also came to Pharaoh's people,
verse.verse_42: but they belied all Our signs so We seized them with the seizing of the Mighty, Powerful.
verse.verse_43: What then, are your unbelievers better than those? Or do you have an immunity (written) in the Scrolls?
verse.verse_44: Or do they say: 'We are a gathering that will be victorious'
verse.verse_45: Most certainly their gatherings shall be routed, and they will turn their backs.
verse.verse_46: Rather, the Hour is their encounter. And that Hour will be most calamitous and bitter.
verse.verse_47: Indeed the wrongdoers are in error and a raging fire.
verse.verse_48: On the Day when they are dragged on their faces into the Fire, (it will be said to them): 'Taste the touch of the Scorching'
verse.verse_49: Indeed, We have created all things according to a measure.
verse.verse_50: And Our Order is but one word like the flashing of an eye.
verse.verse_51: And We destroyed those like you, is there any that will remember!
verse.verse_52: All their deeds are in the Scrolls,
verse.verse_53: everything, be it great or small, is recorded.
verse.verse_54: Indeed, the cautious shall live amid gardens and a river,
verse.verse_55: in a secure abode, in the presence of the Powerful King.
